dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the maximum lateral width at the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical expansion visible on the right lateral margin relative to the left margin at the mid-body plane.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Predominantly off-white/mature white skin tone with uniform median pixel intensity across the majority of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse greyish-blue pigmented clusters visible along the posterior mid-axial line and lower lateral regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the primary off-white baseline and the localized greyish pigmented regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark transverse blowhole slit at the anterior apex of the head.
